title: Warm Home Discount 2026/27: Who Gets £150?
description: The £150 Warm Home Discount has reopened for winter 2026 to 2027. Who qualifies in England, Wales and Scotland, how it’s paid and other help to claim.
intro: The scheme reopened in October for winter 2026 to 2027. Most eligible households don’t need to do anything, but it’s worth checking.

image.alt: A white radiator under a wooden window

cardText: Eligibility, how it’s paid and other winter help.

sections.html: The Warm Home Discount is £150 off your electricity bill, not a cash payment. If you prepay, your supplier may give you a top-up voucher instead. If your supplier provides both fuels, you may be able to have it on your gas bill.

• England and Wales: households getting the Guarantee Credit part of Pension Credit, and low-income households on qualifying means-tested benefits. Most get it automatically and receive a letter.
  • Scotland: you may need to apply to your energy supplier.
  • Northern Ireland: the scheme isn’t available.

• Winter Fuel Payment: £100 to £300 if you were born on or before 27 June 1960 (taken back if your income is over £35,000).
  • Cold Weather Payment: for each 7-day cold spell, if you get certain benefits.
